claims.claim: Customized PS4 big, with 2 pads, 7 games and complete accessories
claims.evidence: Witness photos show two red printed board-game style boxes labeled with text like 'SHOW GAMES' and 'POOL GAMES'—no PS4 console, controllers/pads, or game discs/cases are shown.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired
claims.evidence: No PS4 console or controllers are shown; only printed boxes are visible, so the condition/opening/repaired status cannot be confirmed.
No console ports or power-on test are shown.

claims.claim: Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt
claims.evidence: No pads/controllers or receipt are shown in the witness photos.

risks.risk: Item mismatch/scam risk: seller describes a PS4 bundle, but the witness only saw board-game style boxes.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo/video showing the actual PS4 console (front/back ports), both controllers/pads, and the 7 games together in one frame.
risks.if_unproven: Price as board-game boxes only (worst case: incomplete/unknown game contents), not as a PS4 bundle.

risks.risk: Unknown exact game name/model/edition: the witness text is partially readable ('SHOW GAMES', 'POOL GAMES') and brand/model are not confirmed.
risks.proof: Request a close-up of the front and side panels showing the full game title, publisher/brand, and any barcode/edition details.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic/unknown board-game packaging with uncertain contents.

risks.risk: Missing or damaged contents inside the boxes (cards/pieces/rules), since contents are not shown.
risks.proof: Request photos of the box contents laid out (all pieces/cards) and a photo of the rulebook/contents list.

risks.risk: Reprints/custom/repurposed packaging: could be customized or not original retail sets, affecting value.
risks.proof: Request photos of manufacturing details (barcode, publisher, year) and any authenticity markers.
risks.if_unproven: Price as lower-value customized/possibly non-original packaging.

proof_requests: Show the exact item being sold: a clear photo/video of the PS4 console (if that’s what it is) with both controllers/pads and the 7 games visible together.
If it is actually board games: provide close-ups of the full game titles, publisher/brand, barcode, and year on each box.
Open one box and photograph all contents laid out (cards/pieces/rules) to confirm completeness and condition.
Provide a photo of the UK receipt (or a scan) matching the items.
response.reason: The witness photos do not match the seller’s PS4 bundle description, so a reliable worst-case price for the claimed item cannot be set without confirming what the buyer will actually receive.
